title: AAPL — Apple
html:
Close: $343.46 · YTD: +26.7% · Off high: −1.3% (record $348.15, Oct 13) Trend: strong uptrend — above the 20-day ($337.42), 50-day ($325.69) and 200-day ($292.14). RSI(14): 62 · ATR(14): $6.69 a day Note: Apple held up (+2.0%) in a week when the Nasdaq fell 4.5% — relative strength.

Fibonacci map

The levels that matter

  • Breakout level: $348.15 (record high). A close above opens the 127.2% extension at $376.82.
  • Support 1: $337.42 (20-day).
  • Support 2 — strongest: $323–326, where the 23.6% Fib ($323.28) meets the 50-day ($325.69).
  • Read: healthy uptrend; the best risk/reward entries come on pullbacks toward support, not at the high.

Earnings: Nov 2, 2026 (EPS est. ~$1.98).
